def png(path,arr):
 data=np.ascontiguousarray(np.flipud(np.clip(arr*255+.5,0,255).astype(np.uint8)))

 raw=b''.join(b'\0'+row.tobytes() for row in data)
 path.write_bytes(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',arr.shape[1],arr.shape[0],8,6,0,0,0))+chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(raw,6))+chunk(b'IEND',b''))

def densify(points,step=.021):
 pts=[Vector(p) for p in points];result=[pts[0]]
 for a,b in zip(pts[:-1],pts[1:]):
  n=max(1,math.ceil((b-a).length/step))
  result.extend(a.lerp(b,j/n) for j in range(1,n+1))

def laid_rope(name,points,r=.022,step=.023,pitch=.15):
 pts=densify(points,step);vs=[];fs=[];dist=[0]
 for a,b in zip(pts[:-1],pts[1:]):dist.append(dist[-1]+(b-a).length)
 prev=None;sides=12
 for i,p in enumerate(pts):
  tangent=(pts[min(i+1,len(pts)-1)]-pts[max(0,i-1)]).normalized()
  side=tangent.cross(Vector((0,0,1))) if prev is None else prev-tangent*prev.dot(tangent)
  if side.length<.001:side=tangent.cross(Vector((0,1,0)))
  side.normalize();other=tangent.cross(side);prev=side
  phase=dist[i]/pitch*math.tau
  for j in range(sides):
   a=j/sides*math.tau
   radius=r*(.87+.13*math.cos(3*(a-phase)))
   vs.append(tuple(p+radius*(side*math.cos(a)+other*math.sin(a))))
 for i in range(len(pts)-1):
  for j in range(sides):fs.append((i*sides+j,i*sides+(j+1)%sides,(i+1)*sides+(j+1)%sides,(i+1)*sides+j))
 fs.extend([tuple(reversed(range(sides))),tuple((len(pts)-1)*sides+j for j in range(sides))])

 return ob
